_about: John Ball (1585-1640), Puritan minister of Whitmore, Staffordshire: A Treatise of the Covenant of Grace (London, 1645, posthumous, with an epistle signed by Edward Reynolds, Thomas Hill, Daniel Cawdrey and others). Early English Books Online scans on the Internet Archive; raw OCR of 17th-century type (long s, ligatures), poor in places. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.

_identity_checked.ball-covenant-of-grace-1645: The OCR garbles the name on the title page ('that faithfull servant of Jesus Christ ... of the Gospel, Jo HN Bang'). The epistle to the reader, signed by Edward Reynolds, Thomas Hill, Daniel Cawdrey and others, commends 'the Reverend Authour' by 'His Catechisme, with the exposition thereof; his Treatise of the life of Faith', which are John Ball's.
